craft_notes: Sthāyin: śeṣavṛtti unit 43. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 6. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: All-going even as wind by fan sustained; all-pervading thing-doing mantra-cakra from rising so would be.
